properties.mlm:pretrained_source: Global annual satellite embeddings produced by Google and Google DeepMind.

mlm:input.name: earth-observation-time-series
mlm:input.description: Optical and radar Earth observation imagery and ancillary data used by AlphaEarth Foundations to produce the annual embeddings.

mlm:output.name: embedding
mlm:output.description: 64-dimensional annual per-pixel embedding (channels A00–A63), decoded from signed 8-bit integers to floats in [-1, 1].

processing.lineage: Annual AlphaEarth Foundations embeddings are read from a STAC collection as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs and decoded by the openEO user-defined process alphaearth_embeddings. Each signed 8-bit channel value v is converted with float_val = math.copysign((v / 127.5) ** 2, v).

publications.citation: AlphaEarth Foundations: An embedding field model for accurate and efficient global mapping from sparse label data. arXiv:2507.22291 (2025).
